output: SELECT mo.name AS model_name, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN mt.bike_id IS NOT NULL THEN b.bike_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT b.bike_id), 1) AS pct_with_maintenance FROM model mo LEFT JOIN bike b ON b.model_id = mo.model_id LEFT JOIN maintenance mt ON mt.bike_id = b.bike_id GROUP BY mo.model_id, mo.name ORDER BY mo.name;
